title: Warren Buffett Clearly Loves Apple's (NASDAQ:AAPL) Stock - TheStreet
text:
Warren Buffett loves him some Action Alerts Plus holding Apple ( AAPL ) .
The billionaire's holding conglomerate Berkshire Hathaway ( BRK.A )  increased its stake in the iPhone maker's stock by roughly 23% in the fourth quarter, according to a new SEC filing on Wednesday. Buffett also disclosed an almost 1.9% stake in struggling drug maker Teva ( TEVA ) .   Meanwhile, executives at Qualcomm ( QCOM ) met with Action Alerts Plus holding Broadcom ( AVGO ) in New York City today to try and move toward a merger.
